messages:
rachel: FYI — auto-fallback flipped /embed-api to soft-degrade for ~40s after a short 502 burst. ops got a flood of inbox items :(

omar: do we still use the max combinator? that tends to amplify coincident signals. Which signals fired?

rachel: 502 spike + backend-kv_miss + slow-db. max-of pushed score over hard threshold.

lee: suggest: replace max-of with weighted-sum + noise_floor. also require either duration >= 45s OR rolling_avg(30s) > thresh. add spike_guard to ignore one-off blips.

ana: console UX: show a compact decision string in the audit row like `policy=soft_v4;score=0.81;contributors=502:0.6,kv:0.15,db:0.06;hint=hysteresis=28s` so on-call can read quickly. add a one-line human reason: "why: 502 burst + cache miss".

omar: agree. retention: keep only IDs + compact blobs in primary audit. store full sampled payloads in S3 at 0.5% for degraded requests; on-call can request a temporary token to fetch (10m TTL).

alert-bot: paging softened: routes <150rps will not page for soft-degrade.

lee: inbox change: bundle degrade events per-route into one thread, show counts + timeline, add quick actions (Snooze 10/30/60m, Annotate, Escalate). Snooze should write `annot=snooze;dur=30m;by=USER` into the audit.

rachel: API ask: decision service expose `/v1/policy/evaluate?route=/embed-api&window=30s` and return a semicolon-delimited flat string only (no nested JSON) so the console can render without parsing helpers. include `stability_hint` and `oscillation_count`.

ana: small safety: add oscillation detector that multiplies hysteresis after 3 flips in 10m. Prevents thrash.

omar: action items: lee -> PR for weighted-sum + spike_guard; ana -> audit blob format doc + sampling costs; rachel -> short runbook snippet for on-call; i'll spec the evaluate endpoint. Thanks :thumbsup:
